:::{#def-einf}
#### Expected information matrix (Fisher information matrix, information matrix)

The **expected information matrix**
[@wikipedia_fisher_information],
also called the **Fisher information matrix**
or just the **information matrix**,
is written $\einf$,
and is the expected value of the negative
[Hessian](#def-hessian) of the log-likelihood,
with the data $\vX$ treated as random:

{{< include sds/_subfiles/intro-MLEs/_eq_def_einf.qmd >}}

:::
